collection.description: A child wonders why they forgot a song they once knew.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) wonders why they forgot a song they once knew.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (teacher), a teacher, explains that practice helps memories last.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that forgetting sometimes is ordinary.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) remembers the song after several tries.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) still forgets a verse and laughs with (teacher).

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The pictures prompt a new song instead.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) recalls a different version of the song.
